result:
My verdict on DG3 round 3 is **PASS**. Finding F-DG3-170 is fixed (CLOSED_VERIFIED) and I raised no new findings.

I reviewed candidate `sha256:f2b4c77a…d1d1d` (757 files), source `ce988e20`, freeze commit `0e820ae`. The candidate ID recomputed the same on the repo and on a complete clone, before and after the runs. All three validators pass with exit 0: `--register DG3`, `--historical --stage DG2` and `--historical --stage DG1`.

**F-DG3-170 (Medium): CLOSED_VERIFIED.** The badge is the one saying an earlier approval was inherited and does not approve the gate.
- My round-2 layout probe, unchanged, now passes 12/12. In round 2 it passed 2/12.
- A new, stricter probe passes 155/155 in English and Arabic, on the Gates list and on the G1 view. It covers seven widths, 320 to 1920 px, including phone widths. At every width:
  - the badge stays inside its card or row;
  - the page never scrolls sideways and nothing is clipped;
  - the full text, ending "(does not approve this gate)" / "(لا يعتمد هذه البوابة)", is shown;
  - the icon sits at the start of the line (left in English, right in Arabic);
  - G1 still reads "Not submitted" / "لم تُقدَّم", and nothing on the page shows as approved.
- I checked the screenshots myself. The disclaimer is fully legible and the Arabic wraps naturally right to left.

**Regression checks: all unchanged on this candidate.**
- **Inherited approval (F-DG3-120):** still holds. The API probe passes 33/33 and the screen probe 94/94. G1 stays draft, with no gate submission or decision rows in the database.
- **Formula repair:** it changed no formula-engine code, only tests, lint rules and the design note.
  - The attach-rate example still gives exactly 100000 SAR.
  - The cost example still gives 500000.
  - Combining a monthly figure with an annual one is still refused.
- **Templates and gates:** the round-1 checks still pass, 139/139 through the API and 42/42 through the screens. They cover:
  - the templates;
  - the business case, Finance validation and no double counting;
  - sequencing, selection and funding;
  - the G4 refusal naming the owners, Finance validation and the initiatives;
  - no certification claim and the provisional branding.
- **Builds and tests:** typecheck, build, lint, unit tests and contrast checks all exit 0 on Node 22 and Node 24. That is 1587 unit tests, plus 190 in the new formula run that blocks code generated from strings. The targeted integration suites pass 156/156.

**Failures and warnings, disclosed:**
- My first stack run exited 127 because I passed relative paths to a script that changes directory. No probe ran, and I re-ran everything with absolute paths. It is kept as `stack-run-0-pathmistake.log` and has nothing to do with the candidate.
- The logs also show some harmless notices: a Fastify deprecation warning, a Vite chunk-size advisory, three npm warnings about pnpm settings, and the three colour pairs documented as intentionally failing contrast.

**Not tested live**, and recorded as PASS on the offline and configuration surface as the assignment directs: the live package registry (D-057), live CI (D-058) and Keycloak sign-in (D-049).

I removed the disposable clone and scratch files. All demo data was synthetic and approves nothing real.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG3/round-3/domain-reviewer.json`
- `reviews/DG3/round-3/domain-reviewer.verifications.json`
- `test-evidence/DG3/domain/round-3/` (logs, probes, and English and Arabic screenshots)
